_comment: Constants and structs shared by C++ and shaders, one source for both (sub-project 2b
shaders/shared/layout.glsl and ohao/gpu/shared_layout.hpp from this file; never edit
those by hand. Struct layouts are std430 (push constants and storage buffers): the
header carries alignas and a static_assert per field offset, so a C++ struct cannot
drift from the shader's. Types: uint, int, float, uint2/int2/float2, uint4/int4/float4,
float4x4. A 3-vector has no portable layout in a struct; use a 4-vector.

constants.name: kCalibrateGroupSize
constants.doc: render_bench's GPU calibration kernel: threads per workgroup

constants.name: kCalibrateElements
constants.doc: the calibration buffer's uint count (1 MiB)

constants.name: kShadowMaxLights
constants.doc: RT shadows: the shadow-casting lights a frame traces at most (the lighting pass's light table), one visibility channel each

constants.name: kShadowLightsPerPixel
constants.doc: RT shadows, realtime: the lights a pixel traces at most, the most important first

constants.name: kShadowReferenceRays
constants.doc: RT shadows, reference quality: rays a light a pixel a frame

constants.name: kShadowHistoryFrames
constants.doc: RT shadows, realtime: the temporal accumulation's longest history (its smallest blend weight is 1/this)

constants.name: kShadowFilterTile
constants.doc: RT shadows' filter: the pixels a workgroup filters, this many on a side

constants.name: kShadowFilterRadius
constants.doc: RT shadows' filter: the spatial kernel's radius (5x5)

constants.name: kGIMaxLights
constants.doc: RT GI: the lights a bounce is lit by, the frame's brightest by intensity

constants.name: kGIRealtimeRays
constants.doc: RT GI, realtime: cosine rays a half-resolution pixel a frame

constants.name: kGIReferenceRays
constants.doc: RT GI, reference quality: cosine rays a full-resolution pixel a frame

constants.name: kGIHistoryFrames
constants.doc: RT GI, realtime: the long temporal accumulation's longest history (its smallest blend weight is 1/this)

constants.name: kGIFastHistoryFrames
constants.doc: RT GI, realtime: the short accumulation's longest history; its neighbourhood's range clamps the long one

constants.name: kGITile
constants.doc: RT GI's denoiser: the pixels a workgroup of the temporal pass covers, this many on a side

constants.name: kSSSTile
constants.doc: SSS: the side of a classified tile in pixels (a workgroup of the blur covers one)

constants.name: kSSSMaxTiles
constants.doc: SSS: tiles the classification buffer holds (an 8192x8192 frame)

constants.name: kSSSHeaderWords
constants.doc: SSS: the classification buffer's header, uints: the vertical blur's indirect dispatch (x, y, z, pad), then the horizontal blur's; the per-tile mask, the vertical list and the horizontal list follow, kSSSMaxTiles uints each

constants.name: kSSSRadiusTiles
constants.doc: SSS: the tile rows above and below a skin tile the horizontal blur also covers (the vertical kernel reaches 3 x width <= 32 px)

constants.name: kInstanceGpuStride
constants.doc: render::InstanceGpu's size in bytes (the instance table RT GI reads its bounce albedo from)

constants.name: kInstanceGpuGiAlbedoOffset
constants.doc: the byte offset of InstanceGpu::giAlbedoPacked (rgb: the bounce albedo)

fields.name: iterations
fields.doc: hash rounds per element

structs.name: ShadowLight
structs.doc: one shadow-casting light as RT shadows trace it (a storage buffer of kShadowMaxLights)

fields.name: positionAndType
fields.doc: xyz position (directional: its travel direction; rect: a corner); w type: 0 directional, 1 sphere, 2 rect

fields.name: edge1AndRadius
fields.doc: xyz the rect's first edge (a spot: its unit direction); w the light's bounding radius: a sphere's radius, a rect's half diagonal (directional: angular radius, rad)

fields.name: edge2AndRange
fields.doc: xyz the rect's second edge (a sphere: x the spot's outer-cone cosine, -2 a point light); w the range (0: unlimited)

fields.name: centreAndIntensity
fields.doc: xyz the light's centre (directional: the unit vector toward it), w its intensity: the per-pixel importance

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x width, y height, z lights, w lights a pixel at most (realtime)

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: x render seed, y frame index since the last temporal reset, z quality (0 realtime, 1 reference), w rays a light

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the filter's depth guide is the distance from it)

fields.name: history
fields.doc: x reference: the frames already in the running means (0: start them again)

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x width, y height, z lights, w history frames (0: none)

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: x render seed, y frame index since the last temporal reset: the output's dither

structs.name: GILight

fields.name: positionAndType

fields.name: directionAndRange

fields.name: radiance
fields.doc: xyz colour times intensity; w 0

fields.name: cone
fields.doc: x a spot's inner-cone cosine, y its outer-cone cosine

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the trace's size (realtime: half the frame's, rounded up); z, w the frame's

fields.name: seed
fields.doc: x render seed, y frame index since the last temporal reset, z rays a pixel, w lights

fields.name: flags
fields.doc: x quality (0 realtime, 1 reference), y 1 when an environment map is bound, z reference: the frames already in the running mean (0: start it again)

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the denoiser's depth guide is the distance from it)

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the unjittered view-projection: a direction's end projected to the screen

fields.name: cameraPosRadius
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the blur's depth guide is the distance from it), w the sampling radius in metres

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x bias (metres along the normal), y intensity, z, w the distance falloff's start and end

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the half-resolution size; z, w the frame's

fields.doc: x directions a pixel, y steps a direction; z, w the 4x4 interleaved noise: 4 bits a texel (x + 4y; z texels 0-7, w 8-15), the stratum k of rotation (k + 0.5) / 16 of the angle between two directions

fields.name: viewProj
fields.doc: the view-projection the ray is marched in

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position, w the march's length in metres

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x thickness: how far behind the depth buffer (NDC depth) a sample still hits

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the half-resolution size; z, w the frame's

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the frame's size; z, w its tiles across and down

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x the kernel's step in pixels (its 7 taps reach 3 steps), clamped to 10

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position: the depth weight compares distances from it

fields.name: extent
fields.doc: x, y the half-resolution size; z, w the frame's

fields.name: params
fields.doc: x history frames (0: none), y the a-trous step in pixels

fields.name: cameraPos
fields.doc: xyz the camera's position (the upsample's depth guide)

fields.name: src
fields.doc: the source rectangle of the final image: x, y its origin, z, w its size

fields.name: dst
fields.doc: x, y the preview's size (each at most the source's)
